```{r} library(tidyverse) library(maps) library(ggplot2) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(ggplot2) ``` ```{r} nrhp <- read_csv("../data/Theaters/NRHP_all_theater_types_geocoded.csv") lhat <- read_csv("../data/Theaters/LHAT_theaters.csv") opera <- read_csv("../data/Theaters/opera_america_members.csv") ``` ```{r} # Theater count by state ggplot(nrhp %>% count(State, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_max(n, n = 15), aes(reorder(State, n), n, fill = State)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs( title = "Top 15 States with the Most Historic Theaters (NRHP)", y = "State", x = "Number of Historic Theaters" ) # Opera count by state ggplot(opera %>% count(state, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_max(n, n = 15),aes(reorder(state, n), n, fill = state)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs( title = "Top 15 States with the Most Operas (Opera America)", y = "State", x = "Number of Operas" ) ``` ```{r} # clean and add 'source' column to each dataset nrhp_map <- nrhp %>% mutate( name = `Property Name`, city = City, state = State, latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude, source = "NRHP", .keep = "none" ) lhat_map <- lhat %>% mutate( name = theatre, city = city, state = state, latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude, source = "LHAT", .keep = "none" ) opera_map <- opera %>% mutate( name = name, city = city, state = state, latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude, source = "Opera America", .keep = "none" ) # join all cleaned datasets all_theatres <- bind_rows(nrhp_map, lhat_map, opera_map) ``` ```{r} # Record count of each dataset source_counts <- all_theatres %>% count(source, sort = TRUE) ggplot(source_counts, aes(x = source, y = n, fill = source)) + geom_col() + labs( title = "Number of Theatre Records by Dataset", x = "Dataset", y = "Number of records" ) + theme_minimal() ``` ```{r} # Distribution of NRHP locations by level of significance significance_counts <- nrhp %>% select(starts_with("Level of Significance")) %>% pivot_longer( everything(), names_to = "level", values_to = "present" ) %>% filter(present == TRUE) %>% mutate( level = sub("Level of Significance - ", "", level) ) %>% count(level) ggplot(significance_counts, aes(x = reorder(level, n), y = n)) + geom_col(fill = "maroon") + labs( title = "NRHP Theatre Listings by Level of Significance", x = "Level of Significance", y = "Number of Theatres" ) + theme_minimal() ``` ## NRHP State-level Choropleth ```{r} # count the number of theaters by state state_counts <- nrhp %>% count(State, name = "total_theatres") %>% mutate(region = str_to_lower(State)) # get state map shapes states_map <- map_data("state") # join counts to the map states_theatres <- states_map %>% left_join(state_counts, by = "region") %>% mutate(total_theatres = replace_na(total_theatres, 0)) ``` ```{r} # Choropleth map of NRHP theaters across the US by state ggplot(states_theatres, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) + geom_polygon(aes(fill = total_theatres), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) + coord_fixed(1.3) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") + theme_void() + labs( title = "Number of NRHP Theatres by State", fill = "Theatres" ) ``` ## All Theaters Leaflet ```{r} # remove any rows without coordinates all_theatres_clean <- all_theatres %>% filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) ``` ```{r} # convert to spatial data all_theatres_sf <- all_theatres_clean %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326 ) ``` ```{r} # creating leaflet spatial map of theaters/opera houses from each dataset leaflet(all_theatres_sf) %>% addTiles() %>% addCircleMarkers( data = filter(all_theatres_sf, source == "NRHP"), radius = 3, color = "green", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "NRHP", popup = ~paste0(name, "
", city, ", ", state) ) %>% addCircleMarkers( data = filter(all_theatres_sf, source == "LHAT"), radius = 3, color = "blue", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "LHAT", popup = ~paste0(name, "
", city, ", ", state) ) %>% addCircleMarkers( data = filter(all_theatres_sf, source == "Opera America"), radius = 3, color = "red", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "Opera America", popup = ~paste0(name, "
", city, ", ", state) ) %>% addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("NRHP", "LHAT", "Opera America"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) ```
